cases.name: Jody Gewen Loomis
cases.about: She loved riding her horse. Her sister Jana Loomis-Smith shared she was a talented artist and once painted a mural of running horses on her bedroom walls. She rescued hurt animals and spoke her mind with passion. She was a free-spirit who packed a lot of living in a short time.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; CONVICTION; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED
cases.narrative: Her body was found by couple out target shooting in a wooded area off what is now Mill Creek Road. Semen was found on her body, and on her boot heel and she had been shot in the head.
